description: Compatibility catalog P0, NES mappers part B (34, 41, 64, 66, 67, 69, 71, 119): one case per tested title, played past its title screen. The ROMs are the user's library (X:), not in the repo: the cases skip on a machine without it.

cases.description: Mapper 34. BNROM: 32KB PRG switching with bus conflicts, CHR-RAM. Played past the title (Start presses), FIX/FIX/FIX. Golden recorded from the build that added the mapper; the picture was cross-checked against Mesen 2.1.1 with BrokenDev/tools/diff-nes.ps1 (2026-11-14).

Mapper 34. NINA-001: PRG/CHR registers at $7FFD-$7FFF over PRG-RAM. Played past the title (Start presses), FIX/FIX/FIX. Golden recorded from the build that added the mapper; the picture was cross-checked against Mesen 2.1.1 with BrokenDev/tools/diff-nes.ps1 (2026-11-14).

Mapper 41. Caltron 6-in-1: address-latched outer register, gated inner CHR. Played past the title (Start presses), FIX/FIX/FIX. Golden recorded from the build that added the mapper; the picture was cross-checked against Mesen 2.1.1 with BrokenDev/tools/diff-nes.ps1 (2026-11-14).

Mapper 64. Tengen RAMBO-1: MMC3-like banking with K mode. Played past the title (Start presses), FIX/FIX/FIX. Golden recorded from the build that added the mapper; the picture was cross-checked against Mesen 2.1.1 with BrokenDev/tools/diff-nes.ps1 (2026-11-14).
